Corrected historical scavenged-cluster captures, 2026-11-24

Unmodified f8ddbbbba211d5cb4ec6ca0a1775303ff6fce4b4 did not produce
these three rows: its Things call refused the seed-11 hull, quick and demo
assemblies because a combined mesh had an edge with four adjacent faces.
The original failure logs are in history/historical-public-errors/. Trailing
spaces on their empty stdout lines were removed; the error text is unchanged.

The rows in historical-corrected-scavenged-arm64.txt were captured instead
from f8 plus the touching-part fallback, committed as 567e988f in the
isolated historical reference checkout. That commit changes only
manufacture/good.go. They are corrected-reference captures; they are not
successful output of unmodified f8.

The same three rows were independently captured and matched on the b74
prototype with the same fix, commit 41c4b3ac. The production version of the
fix was committed as 26f69179. The capture ran on Darwin arm64, Go 1.27.3,
GOWORK=off and GOMAXPROCS=2. The selected public producer SHA-256 was
3551acf3fca97e5c118f0c3b76db5342bd4d2a56386471ada6185d2287328094.

Reconstructing the corrected historical source

The isolated commit is not needed to reconstruct its source. From a checkout
containing f8ddbbbba211d5cb4ec6ca0a1775303ff6fce4b4 and this evidence, run:

  mkdir -p /tmp/scavenged-f8/manufacture
  git show f8ddbbbba211d5cb4ec6ca0a1775303ff6fce4b4:manufacture/good.go > /tmp/scavenged-f8/manufacture/good.go
  cp manufacture/testdata/historical-scavenged-touching-parts.patch /tmp/scavenged-f8/fix.patch
  (cd /tmp/scavenged-f8 && git apply --no-index --unidiff-zero fix.patch)
  shasum -a 256 /tmp/scavenged-f8/manufacture/good.go

The zero-context patch changes only manufacture/good.go. Its reconstructed
file was compared byte for byte with good.go from 567e988f. The SHA-256
values below identify the inputs and exact corrected source:

  f8 good.go       483e7984252e12831cf285e027426afc14174930efcf89568c93d38dc46bb4bd
  correction patch 1d5b3101ed51a07893dc77fadaa71f9097e2aa618c0bd32bcb82795c36d00ded
  corrected good.go fdabbab096eca5b70bb5d36687082e5a415b61d5983dca5515d95b885f882245

The original selected producer is reconstructed as documented in
historical-selected-producer-provenance.txt.
